translated_title: "There Would Be No Freedom, Well-Being, or Rights Without Sovereignty," Sheinbaum Says from Tamaulipas
original_title: No habría libertad, bienestar y derechos sin soberanía, dice CSP desde Tamaulipas
author: SinEmbargo Newsroom
meta_description: Inaugurating an IMSS-Bienestar hospital in Tamaulipas, Sheinbaum cast health, education, and housing as rights "and not commodities," inseparable from Mexico's sovereignty.
